name: IGEX-DM
notes: external.inspire_experiment is null: INSPIRE was not consulted (its rate budget belongs to the supervised importer).

Scope: IGEX-DM is the 'dark matter phase of IGEX' with its own low-energy data acquisition ('referred to as IGEX-DM', separate from 'IGEX-2beta'). The IGEX neutrinoless double-beta decay experiment itself is excluded (primarily 0vbb) and is not recorded.
GEDEON ('GErmanium DEtectors in ONe cryostat'), a 'proposed extension of the IGEX dark matter search' (arXiv:astro-ph/0211535), is not recorded: no design report or approval was found.
The COSME detector ran in the same shield at Canfranc; see the same_program lineage row on experiment:cosme.
Latest evidence is a November 2002 status talk; the end is recorded as 'completed' with low confidence and no end date.

physics_goals.note: Phrased as the paper's own aim in its abstract.
physics_goals.quote: These data improve the exclusion limits derived from all the other ionization germanium detectors in the mass region from 20 GeV to 200 GeV, where a WIMP supposedly responsible for the annual modulation effect reported by the DAMA experiment would be located.
physics_goals.value: Search for dark matter WIMPs through the germanium nuclear recoil produced by elastic WIMP scattering, testing the region of the DAMA annual-modulation effect

summary.plain: IGEX-DM was the dark matter search of the International Germanium Experiment. One 2-kilogram germanium crystal, made for a rare-decay study, was used deep under the Pyrenees at Canfranc to look for dark matter particles recoiling off germanium, and set limits on their interaction.
summary.technical: The low-energy data acquisition of an IGEX 76Ge (enriched to 86%) double-beta detector (2.2 kg, ~2.0 kg active; called RG-2 in a 2000 proceedings) with ~4 keV threshold, in IGEX's 2.5 t archaeological-lead shield with muon veto and neutron moderator, in the Canfranc laboratory (2450 m.w.e.). Spin-independent WIMP-nucleon exclusion plots from 30 days (2000) and 40 days (2002) of raw data; the 2002 contour enters the DAMA region.
